About the Venue

Delight Avenues Marquees

A modern luxury marquee in Johar Town, Lahore — grand, column-free halls that stay comfortably air-conditioned, with crystal chandeliers setting the scene from the moment your guests walk in.

The halls host 200 to 1,500 guests, with 250+ valet parking on site. Food is covered too: choose the venue's in-house catering, or bring outside caterers by agreement.

  • Weddings, walima receptions and corporate events
  • Abdul Haque Road, near Shaukat Khanum Hospital, Johar Town
  • Bookings by phone — packages on request

The Venue

Why Choose Delight Avenues

Everything a grand celebration needs, under one roof in Johar Town.

200–1,500

Guest Capacity

From a 200-guest family function to a 1,500-guest grand celebration — the halls scale with your guest list.

Column-Free Halls

Open, column-free halls mean every guest gets a clear view of the stage — fully air-conditioned for comfort in every season.

Crystal Chandeliers

Crystal chandeliers give the halls their signature glow — a luxurious backdrop for photographs and entrances alike.

Valet Parking

Valet parking for more than 250 cars, so your guests arrive and leave without the parking struggle.

In-House Catering

The venue's own in-house catering serves your event — one booking covers both the hall and the food.

Prefer your own caterer? Outside caterers are welcome by agreement with the venue — just ask when you book.
